name: Montenegro

flag.description: A red field with a broad gold border and the gold double-headed eagle coat of arms in the centre, with a lion on the eagle's chest shield.
flag.symbolism: It is based on the royal standard of the Petrović-Njegoš dynasty; the double-headed eagle reflects Byzantine heritage and the lion is an old symbol of the bishop-princes.

hook: Montenegro is a golden double-headed eagle framed in a gold border on red: a gilded version of Albania's black eagle.
trivia: The name Montenegro means 'black mountain' in Venetian Italian.
Montenegro uses the euro, although it is not a member of the European Union.
